name: Vacuum extension 100 mm
description: Short hollow extension for the hand vacuum. Front end: a 35 mm push-in plug matching the nozzle opening (41.8 mm wide, one long side flat, the other curved out, 18 mm high at the ends and 20 mm in the middle; 0.2 mm clearance plus two small crush ribs per long side, 45 degree lead-in). Back end: a 30 mm deep socket of the SAME shape (opening + 0.1 mm per side, small crush ribs inside) where the old brush extension's plug fits. Straight air channel between; the wider tube stops against the nozzle. Prints standing on its wide end (the socket end down), no supports: the socket ceiling is a 45 degree cone. PETG or PLA, 3 perimeters. The old part's clips are not copied: it holds by friction. Print the two short test pieces first. Not printed or fitted.
